messages.text:
BL-1650 — The land step lands a closed-owner stray whose every path is pure evidence or documentation itself (cherry-picked onto main ahead of the replay, recorded in the land log) and treats a closed-owner ancestor whose paths are content-identical to main as landed, not entangled - so a role's incident evidence committed on its long-lived branch after its ticket closed no longer escalates every later land (BL-1636, 2026-09-19)
What it solves: ## What is wrong
Approval context: A new feature file is authored here, so it needs a tap. No choice is posed and there are no ruling_options. FIRM: BL-1546's rule stands for every path that is not pure evidence or documentation - a closed-owner stray touching code, a feature, pipeline steps or backlog YAML is still LAND_ESCALATE, n…
BL-1650 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1650" (or "reject BL-1650 <reason>") to act.

messages.author: swarm
messages.text: BL-1650 🎵 in progress — The land step's landed-sibling verdict walks the same ancestry its entangled detector walks and honours a sibling's own abandoned_commits record, so a closed sibling whose commit rode in on a merge (the everyday pipeline shape) reads LANDED_SIBLING once its content is on main; and it lands a closed-owner stray whose every path is pure evidence itself - on 2026-09-19 BL-1636's replay kept printing ENTANGLED_SIBLING for BL-831 and BL-1634 after the ruled cherry-pick because the verdict walks first-parent commits only
